item.title: About Me
item.description:
Hi! I’m Hanxi Xiao, currently pursuing a Master of Engineering in Financial Engineering at Cornell University.

I hold a BBA in Quantitative Finance from The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen, where I graduated with First Class Honors and received distinctions including the Bowen Scholarship, Academic Excellence, and Excellent Student Leader awards.

My academic interests lie at the intersection of optimization, machine learning, and quantitative trading. I’m passionate about building robust financial models and applying data-driven methods to solve complex problems.

item.title: Projects
item.description:
📈 CSI 500 Index Enhancement Strategy

Developed a multi-factor selection model and mean-variance optimizer. Backtested on CSI 500 constituents, achieving 15.66% annualized return, outperforming the index by 13.55%.

🔄 Technical Timing Strategy

Screened 125+ technical indicators, converted to discrete buy/sell signals, and applied logistic regression scoring. Designed a dynamic long-only timing strategy robust to turnover and cost.

📊 Portfolio Optimization on Bonds

Built bond portfolios under credit rating and duration constraints. Applied PCA to simulate interest rate shifts and used linear programming for allocation.
